name: UPI Transactions
description: The number of payments processed on the Unified Payments Interface each month. In September 2026 UPI handled 24.07 billion transactions worth ₹29.37 lakh crore, up 23% in volume from a year earlier.
releaseSchedule: Released at the start of the following month.

chart.title: Volumes dipped from August but rose 23% on the year
chart.subtitle: UPI transactions, billion, monthly
chart.source: NPCI data via Outlook Money, 2 Oct 2026
